name: avarampl
description: AvaRamp web channel — Vite SPA (frontend) + channel backend (backend) served as one container, with the backend acting as the channel's partner agent toward payment_svc.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @avarampl/backend" "npm run dev -w @avarampl/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @avarampl/frontend && npm run build -w @avarampl/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @avarampl/frontend && npm run typecheck -w @avarampl/backend
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @avarampl/frontend && npm run clean -w @avarampl/backend && rm -rf node_modules
